decision_conditions: In the absence of an adequate Flood Risk Assessment, the proposal fails to demonstrate that flood risk is appropriately managed and mitigated. The submitted FRA does not comply with the requirements for site-specific flood risk assessments and therefore does not adequately assess whether the development be safe for its lifetime. The proposal is therefore contrary to the following policies which seek to ensure that flood risk is suitably addressed:National Planning Policy Framework (December, 2024)Policy SI 12 of the London Plan (March, 2021)DMSI 6 of the Barking and Dagenham Local Plan (September, 2024)

The proposal fails to demonstrate that the proposal would provide safe and suitable parking. In the absence of such, the proposal is found to result in unacceptable parking stress and harm to highway safety in the vicinity of the application site.  As such, it fails to comply with the following policies:National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (December 2024)Policies T1 and T6.1 of the London Plan (March 2021)Policy DMT2 of the Barking and Dagenham Local Plan (September 2024)
borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
description: Demolition of existing garages and the construction of a new two-storey 3x bed, 5 person dwelling adjacent to 88 Westrow Drive including the construction of a vehicular crossover to the front of the existing dwelling and alterations to the front fenestration
